market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: No single team has ever been >30% likely to win the Champions League in preseason betting markets due to the intense knockout competition. PSG lost Mbappe in 2024 and, while still a strong side, faces elite rivals like Real Madrid and Manchester City. True probability is around 10%, making a 58.5% market price a vast overestimate.
evidence_points: PSG’s continued underperformance in Champions League – only one final appearance in history
Loss of Kylian Mbappe to Real Madrid in 2024 weakens squad quality
Bookmaker odds consistently show top CL favourites around 15-20%, never near 58%
sources_consulted: General football knowledge of PSG squad and Champions League history
Knowledge of typical preseason CL betting odds
